```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)
data_tax <- read.delim('/home/mad149/Metagenome_grassmere/plasmidsaurus_output/Abundance(Ocean_salinity)(2).csv', sep=',')
salinity<- c('Sample3.4', 'Sample5.2', 'Sample11.5', 'Sample17.2', 'Sample22.3', 'Sample30.2', 'Sample30.8', 'Sample_32.3')
taxa_first_to_last <- c('Haloferacaceae', 'Haloarculaceae',  'Halorutilaceae','Halomonadaceae',"Salinibacteraceae" ,'Nanosalinaceae', 'Microbacteriaceae', 'Nitrococcaceae', 'Pseudohongiellaceae', 'Vibrionaceae', 'Alteromonadaceae' , 'Cyanobiaceae', 'Rhodobacteraceae', 'Desulfobacteraceae', 'Pelagibacteraceae', 'Flavobacteriaceae' , 'UBA4575', 'Oleiphilaceae' , 'Burkholderiaceae', 'Porticoccaceae', 'BM103','Wenzhouxiangellaceae','Propionibacteriaceae','PWNQ01','Other')

data_tax$Family <- factor(data_tax$Family, levels=rev(taxa_first_to_last))
data_tax$Sample_id <- factor(data_tax$Sample_id, levels = salinity)
ggplot(data_tax, aes(fill=data_tax$Family, y=Abundance, x=data_tax$Sample_id)) + geom_col() + scale_fill_manual(values=c("Salinibacteraceae" = "red", 'Haloferacaceae' = 'deepskyblue', 'Haloarculaceae' = 'blue', 'Nanosalinaceae' = 'black', 'Halomonadaceae' = 'cyan', 'Halorutilaceae' = 'aquamarine'
))+
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 18))+
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 14))+ theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 14))+ theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 16))


data_tax$Sample_id <- factor(data_tax$Sample_id, levels = salinity)
ggplot(data_tax, aes(fill=data_tax$Family, y=Abundance, x=data_tax$Sample_id)) + geom_col() + scale_fill_manual(values=c('Microbacteriaceae' = 'gold2', 'Nitrococcaceae' = 'green'))


data_tax$Sample_id <- factor(data_tax$Sample_id, levels = salinity)
ggplot(data_tax, aes(fill=data_tax$Family, y=Abundance, x=data_tax$Sample_id)) + geom_col() + scale_fill_manual(values=c('Microbacteriaceae' = 'gold2', 'Nitrococcaceae' = 'green',"Salinibacteraceae" = "red", 'Haloferacaceae' = 'deepskyblue', 'Haloarculaceae' = 'blue', 'Nanosalinaceae' = 'black', 'Halomonadaceae' = 'cyan', 'Halorutilaceae' = 'aquamarine'
))+
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 18))+
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 14))+ theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 14))+ theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 16))



ggplot(data_tax, aes(fill=data_tax$Family, y=Abundance, x=data_tax$Sample_id)) + geom_col() + scale_fill_manual(values=c('Microbacteriaceae' = 'gold2', 'Nitrococcaceae' = 'green',"Salinibacteraceae" = "red", 'Haloferacaceae' = 'deepskyblue', 'Haloarculaceae' = 'blue', 'Nanosalinaceae' = 'black', 'Halomonadaceae' = 'cyan', 'Halorutilaceae' = 'aquamarine', 'Pseudohongiellaceae' = 'purple', 'Vibrionaceae' = 'pink', 'Alteromonadaceae' = 'salmon', 'Cyanobiaceae' = 'darkgreen', 'Rhodobacteraceae' = 'brown', 'Desulfobacteraceae' = 'beige', 'Other'='grey', 'Pelagibacteraceae' = 'darkseagreen', 'Flavobacteriaceae' = 'coral', 'UBA4575' = 'yellow', 'Oleiphilaceae' = 'lightblue2', 'Burkholderiaceae' = 'brown1', 'Porticoccaceae' = 'cornflowerblue', 'BM103' = 'darkmagenta','Propionibacteriaceae' = 'gray45','Wenzhouxiangellaceae'='chartreuse4','PWNQ01' = 'deeppink'))+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 28),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```
